content.comment_body: Hello, I've encountered a persistent issue for a while now. Everything operates as expected, except the [product_name] web page loads extremely slowly. Is there any way to improve the loading speed? Even within a LAN, the page loads too slowly. Best regards, [user_name]
If you currently have [product_name] [version_no], the loading of its web pages is notably slow. There's currently no way to accelerate this. Multiple forum discussions have addressed this topic.
Occasionally, the page becomes nearly unusable; sometimes it loads quickly, but other times it's very slow. Is a firmware update planned to address this? Regards, [user_name]

Based on an earlier statement from the official support account, improvements to this issue were anticipated for the next version, [product_name] [version_no]. Only [company_name] can confirm release timelines; forum users aren't able to provide estimates. For the current [product_name] [version_no], it seems unlikely that a firmware update will resolve the problem.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report ongoing slow performance when loading web pages on [product_name] [version_no], including in local networks. At times, the sluggishness is severe enough to hinder usability, although loading speed can sometimes improve. There is a sense of frustration due to the absence of effective solutions or updates, and users remain uncertain about future improvements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliably faster page loading, seeking either a configuration workaround, firmware update, or new product release that addresses the current performance limitations.
